Only taken=true events with a real timestamp are imported. No event dose or source timezone exists; dose remains unknown and the absolute instant is stored in UTC. Medication definitions are not treated as historical doses.
Source medication definitions are evidence only; no current regimen or reminders are created.
Choose an existing HRT Log medication for “%1$s” · %2$s · %3$s
No saved medications are available; these events cannot be linked safely.
Not imported: source logs marked taken=false (%1$d); no missed-dose event is created.
Blood tests are not imported: Chrysalide stores a date-only field through a Date object, with no sample-time/time-zone precision proof.

IDs are local auto-increment values, not device identities. The full export plus row content is used for idempotency; a reused ID with different content is treated as an ambiguous conflict. Local edits are never overwritten and deleted records stay deleted.
